title: DHCP server
subtitle: Configure address scopes, leases and the network options handed to clients

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.emptyHint: Create your first scope so the server can start assigning addresses.
scopes.disableConfirm: Once disabled, this scope stops handing out addresses. Existing leases are unaffected.
scopes.deleteConfirm: Delete scope {name}? Its exclusions and reserved leases will be removed too.

form.name: Scope name
form.newNameHelp: Leave blank to keep the current name.
form.rangePreview: {count} addresses will be available in this range
form.rangeInvalid: Start and end addresses must be in the same subnet, and the start must not be greater than the end
form.leaseTimeHelp: Clients attempt to renew before the lease expires.
form.offerDelayHelp: Controls the order in which this server responds when multiple DHCP servers are present.
form.pingCheckHelp: Prevents assigning addresses that are already in use as static IPs.
form.domainSearchListHelp: One entry per line. Clients try each in turn to complete short hostnames.
form.dnsOverwriteForDynamicLease: Allow dynamic leases to overwrite existing records
form.useThisDnsServerHelp: When enabled, the DNS server list does not need to be filled in manually.
form.allowOnlyReservedLeasesHelp: Unknown devices cannot obtain an address when this is enabled. Suitable for strict admission environments.
form.blockLocallyAdministeredMacHelp: Filters out randomized MACs commonly produced by mobile device privacy features.
form.ignoreClientIdentifierHelp: Some clients use DHCP option 61 instead of the MAC as identifier. Enabling this avoids duplicate leases.

exclusions.title: Exclusions
exclusions.hint: These addresses are never assigned automatically. Typically reserved for printers, servers and other static devices.

reservedLeases.title: Reserved leases
reservedLeases.hint: Bind a fixed address to a specific MAC so the device always receives the same IP.
reservedLeases.invalidMac: Enter a MAC address like AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF

staticRoutes.title: Static routes (option 121)
staticRoutes.hint: Additional route entries published to clients.

genericOptions.title: Custom DHCP options
genericOptions.hint: Set an option code and raw value directly, for options that are not built in.

leases.title: Leases
leases.subtitle: Currently assigned and reserved addresses
leases.searchPlaceholder: Search by address, host name or MAC…
leases.emptyHint: Leases will appear here once clients request addresses.
leases.removeConfirm: Release the lease for {address}? The device will obtain an address again on its next request.
leases.convertToReservedHint: Permanently bind this address to the current MAC.
leases.convertToDynamicHint: Unbind the address and return it to the assignable pool.

dnsIntegration.title: DNS integration
dnsIntegration.hint: When enabled, the server creates A and PTR records for every lease and keeps them in sync as leases change.
dnsIntegration.requiresZone: A primary zone matching the domain must exist, otherwise records cannot be written.
